test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is '**contributory**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate title of the given passage is 'Nutrition in children'. • The most appropriate word for the fourth blank is 'contributory'. • It means 'helping to cause or produce something'. (उत्‍पन्‍न करने में सहायक) • Example: Alcohol was a contributory factor in her death. • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **advisory**: giving advice only; not having the power to make decisions. (केवल सलाहकारी; निर्णय करने के अधिकार से वंचित) • **explanatory**: giving an explanation. (व्‍याख्‍यायुक्त, व्‍याख्‍यात्‍मक, स्‍पष्‍टीकरणात्‍मक) • **contradictory**: being opposite to or not matching something else. (विरोधात्‍मक, असंगत, प्रतिकूल) **Correct Passage:__*** The most urgent areas of attention and immediate action are nutrition, health and education of children, whose well-being reflects the health of the society and caring outlook of the polity. Since the causes of malnutrition of children are many, like exploding population, bias against the female child, weak and suffering mothers, the remedy calls for ‘care of the mother and care by mother’, besides, an effective control over population explosion. Ignorance on what food should be taken is another **contributory** factor that results in malnutrition among women and children. The implementation of various schemes to fight the (5)________ of malnutrition and undernourishment of children requires planning, co-ordination and monitoring by high-powered bodies right down to the village level.* 53:Tea2, The correct answer is '**menace**'.
